name: foundry
description: The foundation: idea → guided brainstorm → ADRs + precise issues → value-first roadmap → gated execution loop, backed by pluggable trackers (YouTrack, DevHubTracker, or explicitly bound Linear) and code-hosts. Linear cutover remains separate and its ADR knowledge-base limitation is explicit. Delegated identities: Lupin, Eiffel, Maigret, and Vauban.

YOUTRACK_TOKEN.title: YouTrack permanent token
YOUTRACK_TOKEN.description: perm-… token with project read/write. Stored in your OS keychain.

LINEAR_API_TOKEN.title: Linear personal API key
LINEAR_API_TOKEN.description: Linear API key for the explicitly registered team/project binding. Stored in your OS keychain.

DEVHUB_URL.title: Dev Hub instance URL
DEVHUB_URL.description: Base HTTP(S) URL of a DevHubTracker v1 instance

DEVHUB_TRACKER_TOKEN.title: DevHubTracker service token
DEVHUB_TRACKER_TOKEN.description: High-entropy scoped service credential. Stored in your OS keychain.

DEVHUB_TRACKER_PROOF_SECRET.title: DevHubTracker proof secret
DEVHUB_TRACKER_PROOF_SECRET.description: Independent HMAC authority for bounded review/done/ADR proofs.

DEVHUB_COMMAND_TOKEN.title: DevHub Foundry command token
DEVHUB_COMMAND_TOKEN.description: Narrow service credential with command claim/event scopes only. Stored in your OS keychain.

FOUNDRY_TRACKER.title: Tracker provider
FOUNDRY_TRACKER.description: youtrack (default) | devhub | linear (explicit issue lifecycle; no ADR KB) | ghprojects (stub)

FOUNDRY_LOCAL_SCOUT_ENABLED.title: Enable local preprocessing
FOUNDRY_LOCAL_SCOUT_ENABLED.description: Trusted opt-in only: 0 (default) or 1. This local model never becomes a Foundry role or gate.

FOUNDRY_LOCAL_SCOUT_BASE_URL.title: Local Scout loopback URL
FOUNDRY_LOCAL_SCOUT_BASE_URL.description: Required only when enabled: exactly http://127.0.0.1:<port> or http://[::1]:<port>.

FOUNDRY_LOCAL_SCOUT_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_S.title: Local Scout connection timeout (seconds)
FOUNDRY_LOCAL_SCOUT_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_S.description: Trusted timing budget only: a finite number greater than 0 and at most 10. This does not enable local preprocessing or select an endpoint, model, or fallback.

FOUNDRY_LOCAL_SCOUT_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_SECOND.title: Local Scout total timeout (seconds)
FOUNDRY_LOCAL_SCOUT_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_SECOND.description: Trusted timing budget only: a finite number greater than 0, at most 120, and no less than the connection timeout. This does not enable local preprocessing or select an endpoint, model, or fallback.

FOUNDRY_LOCAL_SCOUT_CLOUD_FALLBACK.title: Legacy cloud fallback authorization
FOUNDRY_LOCAL_SCOUT_CLOUD_FALLBACK.description: Deprecated 0.x compatibility alias: 0 or 1. Migrate to FOUNDRY_LOCAL_SCOUT_ON_FAILURE before 1.0. A legacy 1 remains effective when Claude injects the canonical manifest default error.

FOUNDRY_LOCAL_SCOUT_ON_FAILURE.title: Local Scout failure policy
FOUNDRY_LOCAL_SCOUT_ON_FAILURE.description: Trusted canonical policy: error (default) or cloud_economy. An explicit direct canonical value wins; cloud_economy emits one in-process host-facade plan with sanitized evidence and the resolved route, never a cloud invocation.
